headline: The plan is decided: agents build 107 of 116 units, the Prototype comes first, and launch moves to March. Next is the plan freeze, then the build starts Oct 26.

decisionsNeeded.title: Approve the frozen plan
decisionsNeeded.detail: The PM has applied your decisions to every plan file and regenerated them. Approving the diff lets the PM commit; you run the tag command it prints. From then on the plan files are read-only and reality goes in the delta log.
decisionsNeeded.impact: Starts the build on Oct 26. Every week the freeze slips moves every date by a week.

heldUp.what: Real-job only: legal review, sponsor terms, Stripe review
heldUp.waitingOn: Client facts with no one to ask in this demo; logged, not blocking

decisionsMade.what: Agents get more of the build: they carry half of each unit Dave leads and build the six non-money pattern-setters; Dave keeps holds, payments, and the ledger
December 1 moves: the client sees the Prototype in early December; launch moves to March
The PM set up the project board fields and linked it to the repo
Agents merge their own work in two tiers; Dave reviews money and access code in a weekly batch
A clickable Prototype comes first, then the full build
A merge desk unit (U-118) is added; Dave builds it first
Dave's time is 10 to 15 hours a week
Figma Code Connect stays unpublished (the Figma plan refuses it)
Scope: 116 build units; Stripe estimated but not built; the Shoulds are cut first
Stack: Next.js, Neon Postgres, a fake payment gateway for the demo, Vercel
Look and feel: "Sunday paper"; mobile first
PRD v1.0 signed: 78 requirements, 14 judgment calls

watch.detail: The plan assumes agent-built units cost Dave little: about 180 h for 116 units, roughly 13x leverage; the only measured figure is 3.4x. Checked after the first three merges and the first two promotions.

watch.what: The money core is the critical path
watch.detail: Holds, then payment intake, then confirming orders, then gifting. A slip there moves launch day for day.

watch.what: Review time is about 68 h, not the 30 h hoped for
watch.detail: People checks, escalations, and the weekly promotion remain under the new merge rule.
